title: LogEvent
description: One entry in the append-only progress log. Every view of progress is derived from these.

Phase.description: recheck: LTF-41, two math problems on a skill another one rests on, after that one stalled.

correct.description: Right on the first try with no hint

interest.description: The passage matched one of the learner's interests

level.description: The item's text level, so the level staircase has a record

delay.description: Guided practice: seconds the clue waited before showing (0 = shown at once on a new skill's first item, LTF-01).

card.description: A reasoning card (Clue, What I know, So) was shown before this answer (LTF-02).

shown.description: LTF-38: two wrong taps, so the answer was shown ("Now you've seen how").

rapid.description: LTF-38: the first tap came faster than the question could be read. Set aside: no points, and it never counts toward or against mastery.

view.description: LTF-42 pilot: a math problem answered while it showed as a short story or as plain numbers. Missing means plain.

points.description: LTF-38: flight points this answer earned, saved when it was given (4 right on the first tap, 2 with the clue, -1 when shown, 0 for a fast guess). Older answers without it earned 2.

pictures.description: LTF-56: picture support was on when he answered, so the grown-ups can compare with and without it.

asked.description: LTF-49: he said he was not sure and was asked to get a grown-up's help, so the answer counts as helped, like the clue.

module.description: LTF-39: the module this belongs to; left out for reading.

reason.description: LTF-38, on a stop: he asked for a break, answers came faster than reading, or the session ended on a success at the time a grown-up set.

module.description: LTF-39: the module this belongs to; left out for reading.

functional.description: Starting step; steps below it start as mastered and enter review

manual.description: Set by an adult rather than by the checks

grammar.description: Share correct on the "Who did it?" sentence grammar stop (LTF-13). Absent when the stop was not run.

module.description: LTF-39: the module this belongs to; left out for reading.

island.description: LTF-36: the island it was built on (a journey stop id). Left out on pieces built before the islands: Home Island.

parts.description: How many parts of the day were told. The words live in the notes store, which has a retention limit.

topic.description: Telling about his day, or about a show or video he watched

sentences.description: How many sentences the built recount had (LTF-08).

feeling.description: LTF-58: he said how he felt about a part of his day. Only the fact is kept, never the words.

feelingWords.description: LTF-58: how many different feeling words from the fixed list he used. Only the count is kept, never the words.

photo.description: LTF-57: a grown-up's photo cue was there. Only the fact; the photo never leaves the device.

after.description: He answered a "What happened after that?" question (LTF-05).

changed.description: Day recounts: how many boxes of the four-panel strip he tapped to change (LTF-06).

ideas.description: From stage 3, day recounts: one entry per question he answered, true if he opened "Show me ideas" for it (LTF-07).

ActivityEvent.description: How a session went, moment to moment: steps entered, idle spells, leaving the app, demo skips, his votes on new things, and (before LTF-38) the bonus for getting past his usual stopping point. Holds no text he wrote.

kind.description: step: entered a step. idle: no touch or key for a while. away: the app was hidden. back: returned from idle or away. skip-demo: pressed 'Got it, skip'. boost: got past his usual stopping point (no longer given since LTF-38). opinion: his answer on a 'What do you think?' card. word-help: he tapped a word for its meaning (LTF-04). word-check: he answered the warm-up's word for today. who-help: he tapped a dotted pronoun to see who it means (LTF-03). route: he chose a route at a fork; item is the island for a sea route (LTF-20), path:<id> for a flight path (LTF-25) and home:<island> on the way home (LTF-27). daytrip: he opened a reached island's day trip; item is the stop (LTF-26). arc: the koala keeper arc began after the eighth koala (LTF-30). home: he chose to fly home after Opening Day (LTF-27). unsure: he pressed "I'm not sure" on a question; item is the question (LTF-49). again: his answer to "Fly again tomorrow?" at the end of a finished session, in like: yes (like), maybe (unsure) or not tomorrow (dislike) (LTF-60). retell: he told a story back from memory with story-map tiles; item is the story-map question, scene whether its picture was shown, correct whether every part was right (LTF-61, a pilot).

from.description: For back: what he returned from.

ms.description: For back: how long the idle spell or absence lasted. For idle: time since the last touch.

feature.description: For opinion: which new thing he was asked about.

scene.description: For retell: the story's scene picture was shown (LTF-61).

correct.description: For retell: every part of the story map was right.

like.description: For opinion: I like it, not sure, or I don't like it.

amount.description: For opinion: too much, just right, or too little.

word.description: For word-help and word-check: the word.

correct.description: For word-check: he picked the right meaning first time.

PictureEvent.description: LTF-51: a picture he asked for and paid for with flight points, drawn by Claude as SVG. What he typed is kept with it.

ask.description: What he asked to have drawn.

svg.description: The picture, already checked to hold no scripts or outside links.

cost.description: Flight points it cost, saved when it was drawn.
